notes.title: Patch 2.23.0 out now! Read on for the Latest Features
notes.content:
Hello there,

We're excited to bring you an update packed with improvements, optimizations, and bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience. 

We also spent a lot of time on the fine-tuning and implementation of the controller vibration feature. This new addition is designed to give you a more immersive gaming experience, allowing you to feel the action as it unfolds. We hope you enjoy it! Read the notes below to find out what's been updated.

[b]New Features
[/b]
• Implemented controller vibration system
• Support for Xbox, PS5 DualSense, PS4 DualShock, and Switch Pro controllers

[b]Gameplay Enhancements
[/b]
• Reduced GPU performance requirements
• Tweak mailbox avatar for computer
• Tweak email attachment button

[b]Bug Fixes
[/b]
• Fixed various typos and linebreaks
• Fixed sound effect issues
• Fixed a missing sprite on Red Chamber’s monitor
• Fixed a display issue with the opening

Thank you all for your support of OPUS: Echo of Starsong, and we hope you'll add our new title OPUS: Prism Peak to your wishlist to get the fastest notification when it's released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1947910/OPUS_Prism_Peak/

SIGONO

notes.title: FREE UPGRADE! Voice Acting Now Available!
notes.content:
[h3]🔥FREE UPGRADE🔥[/h3]
Japanese / Chinese voice acting now available on the Steam version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/156189b0a74e6af8638ea99dfdfda4feb76a59f2.png[/img]

With all-new voice acting, OPUS: Echo of Starsong - Full Bloom Edition is now available on Steam! Taking the critically acclaimed adventure to a whole new level with the addition of Japanese and Chinese Mandarin voiceovers!

This means we’ll be raising the price to reflect the new content. However, to thank those who have supported us since launch, anyone who owns the original OPUS: Echo of Starsong on Steam will receive the Full Bloom Edition at no additional cost.

notes.title: 91 on Metacritic! Official artbook! And recent updates!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, OPUS: Echo of Starsong recently received a high score of 91 on Metacritic! So thank you all for your support and feedback! Also to all the folks who've been asking, the OPUS: Echo of Starsong Official Artbook is out! You can grab it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1504500/OPUS/

[h3]OPUS: ECHO OF STARSONG OFFICIAL ARTBOOK
[/h3]
A curated collection of artwork and designs from the acclaimed title OPUS: Echo of Starsong! Featuring 130+ pages of gorgeous character art, spaceships, and environments, in addition to many previously unseen designs, revealed for the very first time in this beautiful showcase of artistic vision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/d58be3c6cfd463711c4341640e7d64514fc96f8d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/a087318e18d626c47058bbf57a9eba5d6dfa741c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/81403e96ffa61320cd05919ad4db741399b613c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/6b955e04f3c982cab45ff0de9b3987c9dd016af3.png[/img]

[h3]RECENT UPDATES v.1.7.1
[/h3]
We've also been working hard to improve the game's experience. Here's a summary of the changes we made:

- Improved movement control under zero gravity
- Improved performance on lighting intensive areas.
- Improved tutorial with clearer instructions
- Adjusted sound volume on certain cutscenes
- Fixed bug where player have a chance to skip cutscenes under certain movement control
- Fixed bug that causes character teleportation when two character hold hands
- Fixed localization error on CHT, CHS, EN, JP languages
- Added follow us button on main menu

We hope you dig the frankly quite amazing artbook and our recent updates!

notes.title: OPUS: Echo of Starsong - Update v1.4.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/3989094e48ed3a2a7d969488613be8f01d1ebc45.png[/img]

Hey there everyone!

Over the past 2 weeks since launch, we’ve been flooded with kind words and feedback from you guys, and we paid close attention! So the team has been working nonstop to bring you the best experience possible, here is a list of notable changes up until the most recent update:

[h3]UPDATE v1.4.3
[/h3]

- Trading cards!
- New settings (volume controls, graphics, and fps)
- Cloud save support
- Remote play support
- New Retrace Memories menu (allows you jump to a chapter you’ve finished, available to players who played through the game after the 1.4.3 update)
- New All Memories menu (access everything you’ve collected throughout all your playthroughs)
- Fix issue that locks players out of Asteroid 67
- Fix issue that prevents players from getting the achievement "Doesn't need help"
- Various bug fixes

Thanks again for all your support!
